title: Dichroic film
description: A thin translucent membrane rolls through olive, cobalt, and rose interference.
useCase: Give packaging, cosmetics, and experimental identities a distinctive thin-film finish.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. An authored thin-film palette model, not measured spectral material data.
look: Glossy iridescent sphere banded with teal, magenta, olive and deep blue rings, a white softbox highlight and thin green rim on near-black.
motion: Interference bands slowly roll across the bubble as a sine term in the film thickness advances with time; a thickness slider shifts the whole colour sequence.
adapt: All colour comes from the `FRAGMENT` shader: `thickness` drives the cosine `interference` palette (`vec3(17.0,22.0,29.0)` sets hue spacing), `u_time*.12` sets drift speed, and `radius` sizes the sphere. Keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
